Header.value: CampNet · Stage B: full post
1. Mark evidence → 2. Explain each mark → 3. Finish and Submit
Choose a technique, then drag over the supporting words. Click a mark to answer its questions. Write in Bangla or English.
Review the full post afresh. For picture evidence, draw the smallest useful box. Printed words are text evidence.
EXPERIMENTAL MODEL SUGGESTIONS — check, change, or reject them. These are not human labels.
T01 · Loaded Language: Emotional words add praise or blame beyond a plain description.
T02 · Name Calling / Labeling: A judgmental name is given to a person or group.
T03 · Smears: An accusation or degrading connection attacks a reputation.
T04 · Appeal to Fear / Prejudice: A threat or prejudice pushes the reader to support or reject something.
T05 · Exaggeration / Minimisation: The message inflates or plays down scale, certainty, or importance. “All” alone is not enough.
T06 · Slogans: A memorable phrase rallies support or action. A short sentence alone is not enough.
T07 · Appeal to Strong Emotions: A picture creates strong emotion to support a position. Assess this only in Stage B.
Check whether the post supports, neutrally quotes, or rejects a message. Two techniques need two explanations, even when they use the same words.
